fields.name: PgShardSets construction surface
fields.contract: `PgShardSets` provides a constructible shard-set collection whose inherited collection operations are typed for `PgShardConnectionOptions` entries. In its constructor it supplies a new ArgentSea.Pg.DataProviderServiceFactory() together with the bound PgShardConnectionOptions and PgGlobalPropertiesOptions to the ShardSetsBase<PgShardConnectionOptions> base constructor. Like PgDatabases, it adds no members of its own beyond this constructor.
